Sprint 13 — InkOS Flash & Portfolio Page rebuild. You own the database layer.

**Project:** /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS
**Stack:** Next.js 16 + Supabase Postgres + RLS. Project rules: ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md and ./CLAUDE.md (especially §8 Forbidden, §9 Antipatterns, §17 Demo Data).
**Approved plan:** /Users/yashbaldha/.claude/plans/deep-check-page-and-effervescent-babbage.md — read sections 3, 7.1, 9 before writing.

## Your deliverable

ONE migration file at exactly:
`supabase/migrations/20260428100000_s13_flash_inventory.sql`

It must implement everything in plan §3 plus production-grade hardening:

### Schema
1. `flash_sheets` table — inventory groupings (Spring Drop 2026 etc.). Columns per plan §3.1 + UNIQUE(studio_id, slug) + status check + indexes.
2. `flash_pieces` table — sellable inventory. Columns per plan §3.2. CRITICAL: this is **not** the same as `flash_event_designs` (which already exists for scheduled walk-in days). Different concept entirely.
3. ALTER `artist_portfolio_items` — add reference_path/stencil_path/fresh_path/healed_path/healed_at/linked_project_id/ai_tagged_at/view_count per plan §3.3.

### RLS — MANDATORY on every new table
- `flash_sheets`: public SELECT where status='active'; studio members (owner/admin/artist) full write.
- `flash_pieces`: public SELECT where visibility='public' AND status IN (available,reserved,sold) — drafts and retired NEVER leak. Studio members full read+write per role. Inspect existing `studio_members` table first to confirm column names.
- Storage RLS for `flash-pieces` bucket: anon read, authed write.

### RPC
`reserve_flash_piece(p_piece_id uuid, p_client_id uuid, p_booking_id uuid)` — SECURITY DEFINER, atomic, raises `flash_piece_not_available` if status != 'available'. Calls existing `log_audit_action` helper — verify it exists first; if signature differs, adapt. Returns the updated row.

### Storage bucket
`flash-pieces` — public read, 10 MB limit, png/jpg/webp.

### Triggers
Reuse existing `set_updated_at()` trigger function (it's already in the schema — verify before defining a new one). Apply to both new tables.

### Hardening checklist
- Every FK has an index.
- GIN index on `style_tag_ids` array column.
- Partial index on `is_featured = true`.
- All `text` enum-like columns wrapped in CHECK constraints (status, session_length, placement, visibility).
- All money in `_cents integer` (never numeric/float).
- All timestamps `timestamptz`, never `timestamp`.
- No destructive ALTERs — additive only.
- Down-migration comments at top showing rollback SQL.

### Before writing
1. Read these files to confirm schema conventions match:
   - `supabase/migrations/20260425100100_*` (artist_portfolio_items origin)
   - `supabase/migrations/20260422100000_flash_events*`
   - The most recent migrations to see latest patterns
   - Search for `log_audit_action` and `set_updated_at` definitions to confirm signatures
2. Read `lib/supabase/types.ts` (DON'T edit it — confirm `studio_members` shape, `clients`, `bookings`, `projects`, `artists` shape so your FKs reference correct tables/columns)

### After writing
Run:
```bash
cd "/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS"
pnpm db:types   # regenerate lib/supabase/types.ts — verify flash_pieces + flash_sheets types appear
```

If `pnpm db:types` requires a live Supabase project that you can't reach, document the exact command Yash needs to run in your final summary.

### Demo data
Update or extend `scripts/seed/demo/` to seed at least 28 flash_pieces across 3 artists + 1 sheet "Spring Drop 2026" + 4 portfolio items with full progression photos. Match existing demo studio id `11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111`. Keep the seed idempotent.

4. Any deviations from plan §3 with reason.

Do NOT touch anything outside `supabase/migrations/`, `scripts/seed/demo/`, and `lib/supabase/types.ts` (regenerate only). Do NOT write app/component/lib code — that's Koda's job in step 4.

9	## 1. Context — why this rebuild
10	
11	Current `/portfolio` is a thin gallery: title + 1 grid + lightbox modal + 2 chip filters. The PDF audit identified that the page is doing **half a job**: it's a portfolio showcase, but InkOS needs a **dual-mode inventory + showcase system**.

17	**Strategic stakes:** Flash inventory + healed-photo timeline + per-artist public profiles are net-new category-defining features. Closest competitors (Porter, Fresha, Booksy) ship neither. This is a moat-reinforcing build (#1 AI Design Assistant + #4 Transparent pricing both touch this surface).

24	| Public surface | **Path on root domain `/p/[studio]/[artist]`** | Zero DNS work, Next 16 native routing. |

344	### 7.1 Dodo Payments — flash reserve flow

346	Reuse [lib/dodo/client.ts](lib/dodo/client.ts) — lazy-init.

348	1. Public client visits `/p/[studio]/flash/[pieceId]`, clicks **Reserve** → POST `/api/flash/[id]/reserve` with `{ clientEmail, clientName }`.

350	   ```ts
351	   {
352	     return_url: `${SITE_URL}/p/[studio]/flash/[pieceId]?reserved=1`,
353	     metadata: { flash_piece_id: pieceId, studio_id, kind: 'flash_reserve' },
354	     customer: { email, name, billing: { country: 'US' } }, // ISO 3166
355	     amount: piece.deposit_cents,
356	     currency: piece.currency,
357	   }
358	   ```

364	   - Send Resend email: studio gets reservation alert, client gets confirmation w/ booking page link.

262	-- 6. generate_flash_event_slots(event_id)
263	--    Inserts open slots from event start_time → end_time at slot_duration_min
264	--    intervals on event_date. Skips slots that already exist (idempotent).
265	--    Must be called as studio member (service-role in webhook/action).
266	-- ============================================================
267	
268	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION generate_flash_event_slots(p_event_id uuid)
269	RETURNS int  -- returns number of slots generated
270	LANGUAGE plpgsql
271	SECURITY DEFINER
272	AS $$
273	DECLARE
274	  v_event         flash_events%ROWTYPE;
275	  v_slot_start    timestamptz;
276	  v_slot_end      timestamptz;
277	  v_event_tz      text;
278	  v_base_date     date;
279	  v_current       timestamptz;
280	  v_count         int := 0;
281	BEGIN
282	  SELECT * INTO v_event FROM flash_events WHERE id = p_event_id;
283	  IF NOT FOUND THEN
284	    RAISE EXCEPTION 'flash_event not found: %', p_event_id;
285	  END IF;
286	
287	  -- Resolve studio timezone
288	  SELECT timezone INTO v_event_tz FROM studios WHERE id = v_event.studio_id;
289	  v_event_tz := COALESCE(v_event_tz, 'UTC');
290	
291	  v_base_date := v_event.event_date;
292	
293	  -- Build start timestamp in studio local time, then convert to UTC
294	  v_current := (v_base_date::text || ' ' || v_event.start_time::text)::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE v_event_tz;
295	
296	  LOOP
297	    v_slot_start := v_current;
298	    v_slot_end   := v_current + (v_event.slot_duration_min || ' minutes')::interval;
299	
300	    -- Stop if slot_end exceeds end_time
301	    EXIT WHEN v_slot_end > (v_base_date::text || ' ' || v_event.end_time::text)::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE v_event_tz;
302	
303	    -- Respect max_slots
304	    EXIT WHEN v_event.max_slots IS NOT NULL AND v_count >= v_event.max_slots;
305	
306	    INSERT INTO flash_event_slots (flash_event_id, slot_start, slot_end, status)
307	    VALUES (p_event_id, v_slot_start, v_slot_end, 'open')
308	    ON CONFLICT (flash_event_id, slot_start) DO NOTHING;
309	
310	    GET DIAGNOSTICS v_count = ROW_COUNT;
311	    v_count := v_count + 1;  -- approximate; ON CONFLICT may not insert
312	
313	    v_current := v_slot_end;
314	  END LOOP;
315	
316	  -- Re-count actual slots
317	  SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_count FROM flash_event_slots WHERE flash_event_id = p_event_id AND status = 'open';
318	  RETURN v_count;
319	END;
320	$$;

323	-- 7. public_reserve_flash_slot(studio_slug, event_slug, slot_id, client_info)
324	--    SECURITY DEFINER — called by anon public booking page.
325	--    Atomically claims a slot (open → reserved) and creates a pending booking row.
326	--    Returns: { booking_token, slot_id, error? }
327	-- ============================================================
328	
329	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public_reserve_flash_slot(
330	  p_studio_slug  text,
331	  p_event_slug   text,
332	  p_slot_id      uuid,
333	  p_client_info  jsonb  -- { first_name, last_name?, email, phone?, notes? }
334	)
335	RETURNS jsonb
336	LANGUAGE plpgsql
337	SECURITY DEFINER
338	AS $$
339	DECLARE
340	  v_studio       studios%ROWTYPE;
341	  v_event        flash_events%ROWTYPE;
342	  v_slot         flash_event_slots%ROWTYPE;
343	  v_client_id    uuid;
344	  v_booking_id   uuid;
345	  v_booking_token text;
346	  v_artist_id    uuid;
347	BEGIN
348	  -- Resolve studio
349	  SELECT * INTO v_studio FROM studios WHERE slug = p_studio_slug AND status = 'active';
350	  IF NOT FOUND THEN
351	    RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'studio_not_found');
352	  END IF;
353	
354	  -- Resolve event (must be public+published)
355	  SELECT * INTO v_event
356	  FROM flash_events
357	  WHERE studio_id = v_studio.id
358	    AND slug = p_event_slug
359	    AND public = true
360	    AND status = 'published';
361	  IF NOT FOUND THEN
362	    RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'event_not_found');
363	  END IF;
364	
365	  -- Lock and claim slot atomically
366	  SELECT * INTO v_slot
367	  FROM flash_event_slots
368	  WHERE id = p_slot_id
369	    AND flash_event_id = v_event.id
370	    AND status = 'open'
371	  FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED;
372	
373	  IF NOT FOUND THEN
374	    -- Either slot gone or already locked by concurrent request
375	    RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'slot_unavailable');
376	  END IF;
377	
378	  -- Expire stale reservations opportunistically
379	  UPDATE flash_event_slots
380	  SET status = 'open', booking_id = NULL, reserved_until = NULL
381	  WHERE flash_event_id = v_event.id
382	    AND status = 'reserved'
383	    AND reserved_until < now();
384	
385	  -- Upsert client by email within this studio
386	  INSERT INTO clients (studio_id, first_name, last_name, email, phone, source, created_at, updated_at)
387	  VALUES (
388	    v_studio.id,
389	    p_client_info->>'first_name',
390	    NULLIF(p_client_info->>'last_name', ''),
391	    LOWER(TRIM(p_client_info->>'email')),
392	    NULLIF(p_client_info->>'phone', ''),
393	    'public',
394	    now(),
395	    now()
396	  )
397	  ON CONFLICT (studio_id, email) DO UPDATE
398	    SET updated_at = now()
399	  RETURNING id INTO v_client_id;
400	
401	  -- Resolve artist (use event artist if set, else use a placeholder approach)
402	  v_artist_id := v_event.artist_id;
403	  IF v_artist_id IS NULL THEN
404	    -- Pick the first active artist for this studio as a fallback
405	    SELECT id INTO v_artist_id FROM artists
406	    WHERE studio_id = v_studio.id AND status = 'active'
407	    ORDER BY sort_order LIMIT 1;
408	  END IF;
409	
410	  IF v_artist_id IS NULL THEN
411	    RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'no_artist_available');
412	  END IF;
413	
414	  -- Generate booking token
415	  v_booking_token := gen_random_uuid()::text;
416	  v_booking_id    := gen_random_uuid();
417	
418	  -- Create pending booking
419	  INSERT INTO bookings (
420	    id, studio_id, client_id, artist_id,
421	    scheduled_at, duration_min,
422	    status, price_cents, deposit_cents, deposit_paid,
423	    booking_token, source,
424	    notes, client_notes,
425	    location_id, metadata,
426	    consent_required,
427	    created_at, updated_at
428	  ) VALUES (
429	    v_booking_id,
430	    v_studio.id,
431	    v_client_id,
432	    v_artist_id,
433	    v_slot.slot_start,
434	    v_event.slot_duration_min,
435	    'pending',
436	    v_event.slot_price_cents,
437	    v_event.deposit_cents,
438	    false,
439	    v_booking_token,
440	    'public',
441	    NULLIF(p_client_info->>'notes', ''),
442	    NULL,
443	    v_event.location_id,
444	    jsonb_build_object('flash_event_id', v_event.id, 'flash_event_slug', v_event.slug),
445	    false,
446	    now(),
447	    now()
448	  );
449	
450	  -- Reserve the slot (15-minute hold)
451	  UPDATE flash_event_slots
452	  SET status         = 'reserved',
453	      booking_id     = v_booking_id,
454	      reserved_until = now() + interval '15 minutes'
455	  WHERE id = v_slot.id;
456	
457	  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
458	    'booking_token', v_booking_token,
459	    'booking_id',    v_booking_id,
460	    'slot_id',       v_slot.id
461	  );
462	END;
463	$$;
464	
465	-- ============================================================
466	-- 8. confirm_flash_slot_booking(booking_id)
467	--    Called by webhook after deposit paid. Transitions slot reserved → booked.
468	-- ============================================================
469	
470	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION confirm_flash_slot_booking(p_booking_id uuid)
471	RETURNS boolean
472	LANGUAGE plpgsql
473	SECURITY DEFINER
474	AS $$
475	BEGIN
476	  UPDATE flash_event_slots
477	  SET status = 'booked', reserved_until = NULL
478	  WHERE booking_id = p_booking_id
479	    AND status IN ('open', 'reserved');
480	
481	  RETURN FOUND;
482	END;
483	$$;

247	-- ── 6. advance_project_status — state machine with validation + log ──────────
248	-- Allowed transitions (forward):
249	--   planning → deposit_paid | on_hold | cancelled | archived
250	--   deposit_paid → active | on_hold | cancelled | archived
251	--   active → healing | on_hold | cancelled | archived
252	--   healing → completed | active (rollback) | on_hold | archived
253	--   completed → archived | healing (rollback)
254	--   on_hold → planning | deposit_paid | active | healing | cancelled | archived
255	--   cancelled → archived | planning (reopen)
256	-- Non-listed transitions are blocked unless p_force = true.
257	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION advance_project_status(
258	  p_project_id uuid,
259	  p_new_status text,
260	  p_force      boolean DEFAULT false,
261	  p_reason     text DEFAULT NULL
262	) RETURNS void
263	LANGUAGE plpgsql
264	SECURITY DEFINER
265	SET search_path = public
266	AS $$
267	DECLARE
268	  v_old_status text;
269	  v_allowed    boolean := false;
270	BEGIN
271	  IF p_new_status NOT IN ('planning','deposit_paid','active','healing','completed','on_hold','cancelled','archived') THEN
272	    RAISE EXCEPTION 'advance_project_status: invalid status %', p_new_status
273	      USING ERRCODE = '22023';
274	  END IF;
275	
276	  SELECT status INTO v_old_status FROM projects WHERE id = p_project_id FOR UPDATE;
277	
278	  IF v_old_status IS NULL THEN
279	    RAISE EXCEPTION 'advance_project_status: project % not found', p_project_id
280	      USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
281	  END IF;
282	
283	  IF v_old_status = p_new_status THEN
284	    -- no-op; do not log
285	    RETURN;
286	  END IF;
287	
288	  -- Validate allowed transitions
289	  v_allowed := CASE v_old_status
290	    WHEN 'planning'      THEN p_new_status IN ('deposit_paid','on_hold','cancelled','archived')
291	    WHEN 'deposit_paid'  THEN p_new_status IN ('active','on_hold','cancelled','archived','planning')
292	    WHEN 'active'        THEN p_new_status IN ('healing','on_hold','cancelled','archived','deposit_paid')
293	    WHEN 'healing'       THEN p_new_status IN ('completed','active','on_hold','archived')
294	    WHEN 'completed'     THEN p_new_status IN ('archived','healing')
295	    WHEN 'on_hold'       THEN p_new_status IN ('planning','deposit_paid','active','healing','cancelled','archived')
296	    WHEN 'cancelled'     THEN p_new_status IN ('archived','planning')
297	    WHEN 'archived'      THEN p_new_status IN ('planning')
298	    ELSE false
299	  END;
300	
301	  IF NOT v_allowed AND NOT p_force THEN
302	    RAISE EXCEPTION 'advance_project_status: transition % → % not allowed (pass p_force=true to override)', v_old_status, p_new_status
303	      USING ERRCODE = '22023';
304	  END IF;
305	
306	  UPDATE projects
307	  SET
308	    status       = p_new_status,
309	    completed_at = CASE WHEN p_new_status = 'completed' AND completed_at IS NULL THEN now() ELSE completed_at END,
310	    started_at   = CASE WHEN p_new_status = 'active' AND started_at IS NULL THEN now() ELSE started_at END,
311	    stalled_at   = CASE WHEN p_new_status <> 'planning' THEN NULL ELSE stalled_at END
312	  WHERE id = p_project_id;
313	
314	  PERFORM log_project_activity(
315	    p_project_id,
316	    'status_changed',
317	    jsonb_build_object(
318	      'from',   v_old_status,
319	      'to',     p_new_status,
320	      'force',  p_force,
321	      'reason', p_reason
322	    )
323	  );
324	END;
325	$$;

329	-- ── 7. mark_session_completed_project — trigger handler on booking complete ──
330	-- Called from trigger on bookings when status → 'completed' and project_id is
331	-- set. Increments projects.sessions_completed, auto-applies deposit per the
332	-- project's deposit_apply_rule, and may auto-advance status.
333	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mark_session_completed_project(p_booking_id uuid)
334	RETURNS void
335	LANGUAGE plpgsql
336	SECURITY DEFINER
337	SET search_path = public
338	AS $$
339	DECLARE
340	  v_project_id             uuid;
341	  v_session_number         int;
342	  v_project                projects%ROWTYPE;
343	  v_pool_balance           bigint;
344	  v_remaining_sessions     int;
345	  v_per_session_cents      bigint;
346	  v_sessions_after         int;
347	BEGIN
348	  SELECT project_id, session_number
349	    INTO v_project_id, v_session_number
350	    FROM bookings
351	    WHERE id = p_booking_id;
352	
353	  IF v_project_id IS NULL THEN
354	    RETURN; -- booking not linked to a project
355	  END IF;
356	
357	  SELECT * INTO v_project FROM projects WHERE id = v_project_id FOR UPDATE;
358	
359	  -- Bump sessions_completed (idempotent: only bump if this session hasn't been counted).
360	  UPDATE projects
361	  SET sessions_completed = sessions_completed + 1
362	  WHERE id = v_project_id;
363	
364	  v_sessions_after := v_project.sessions_completed + 1;
365	  v_pool_balance   := v_project.deposit_pool_cents - v_project.deposit_applied_cents;
366	
367	  PERFORM log_project_activity(
368	    v_project_id,
369	    'session_completed',
370	    jsonb_build_object(
371	      'booking_id',         p_booking_id,
372	      'session_number',     v_session_number,
373	      'sessions_completed', v_sessions_after
374	    )
375	  );
376	
377	  -- Auto-apply deposit per rule (only when there is balance to apply).
378	  IF v_pool_balance > 0 THEN
379	    IF v_project.deposit_apply_rule = 'last_session'
380	       AND v_project.total_sessions_planned IS NOT NULL
381	       AND v_session_number IS NOT NULL
382	       AND v_session_number = v_project.total_sessions_planned THEN
383	      PERFORM apply_deposit_to_session(v_project_id, p_booking_id, v_pool_balance);
384	
385	    ELSIF v_project.deposit_apply_rule = 'split_evenly'
386	          AND v_project.total_sessions_planned IS NOT NULL THEN
387	      v_remaining_sessions := GREATEST(v_project.total_sessions_planned - v_project.sessions_completed, 1);
388	      -- Split by sessions remaining BEFORE this one completes (so later sessions still get share).
389	      v_per_session_cents := v_pool_balance / v_remaining_sessions;
390	      IF v_per_session_cents > 0 THEN
391	        PERFORM apply_deposit_to_session(v_project_id, p_booking_id, v_per_session_cents);
392	      END IF;
393	    END IF;
394	    -- 'manual' rule: no auto-apply, owner clicks "Apply now" in the ledger.
395	  END IF;
396	
397	  -- Auto-advance deposit_paid → active on first completed session.
398	  IF v_project.status = 'deposit_paid' THEN
399	    PERFORM advance_project_status(v_project_id, 'active');
400	  END IF;
401	
402	  -- Auto-advance active → healing when all planned sessions are done.
403	  IF v_project.status = 'active'
404	     AND v_project.total_sessions_planned IS NOT NULL
405	     AND v_sessions_after >= v_project.total_sessions_planned THEN
406	    PERFORM advance_project_status(v_project_id, 'healing');
407	  END IF;
408	END;
409	$$;
410

413	-- ── 8. flag_stalled_projects — cron helper ───────────────────────────────────
414	-- Marks projects as stalled_at=now() when they've been in 'planning' with no
415	-- activity_log entries (other than 'created') for 45+ days. Returns the count
416	-- of newly flagged rows.
417	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION flag_stalled_projects()
418	RETURNS int
419	LANGUAGE plpgsql
420	SECURITY DEFINER
421	SET search_path = public
422	AS $$
423	DECLARE
424	  v_count int;
425	BEGIN
426	  WITH recent_activity AS (
427	    SELECT project_id, MAX(created_at) AS last_activity
428	    FROM project_activity_log
429	    WHERE event_type <> 'created'
430	    GROUP BY project_id
431	  ),
432	  to_flag AS (
433	    SELECT p.id
434	    FROM projects p
435	    LEFT JOIN recent_activity ra ON ra.project_id = p.id
436	    WHERE p.status = 'planning'
437	      AND p.stalled_at IS NULL
438	      AND COALESCE(ra.last_activity, p.created_at) < now() - interval '45 days'
439	  )
440	  UPDATE projects p
441	  SET stalled_at = now()
442	  FROM to_flag
443	  WHERE p.id = to_flag.id;
444	
445	  GET DIAGNOSTICS v_count = ROW_COUNT;
446	  RETURN v_count;
447	END;
448	$$;
449	
450	-- Invoked by worker/cron only — service role, not authenticated users.
451	REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION flag_stalled_projects() FROM PUBLIC;
452	GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION flag_stalled_projects() TO service_role;

export async function seed(sb: AdminClient, ctx: DemoContext): Promise<void> {
  const [artistId1, artistId2, artistId3] = ctx.artistIds as [string, string, string, ...string[]]

  if (!artistId1 || !artistId2 || !artistId3) {
    throw new Error('[flash-inventory] ctx.artistIds must have at least 3 entries — run members seed first')
  }

  // ── 1. flash_sheets — 1 active sheet "Spring Drop 2026" ───────────────────
  const sheetId = detId('flash_sheet', 'spring-drop-2026')

  const { error: sheetErr } = await sb.from('flash_sheets').upsert(
    {
      id: sheetId,
      studio_id: ctx.studioId,
      title: 'Spring Drop 2026',
      slug: 'spring-drop-2026',
      description: 'Twenty-eight original designs available this season. Each piece is ready to book immediately — no waitlist.',
      cover_image_url: `https://demo-flash.inkos.test/${sheetId}/cover.jpg`,
      drop_date: '2026-04-28',
      status: 'active' as const,
      created_by: DEMO_USERS.owner.id,
    },
    { onConflict: 'id' },
  )
  if (sheetErr) throw new Error(`[flash-inventory] flash_sheets upsert: ${sheetErr.message}`)
  log.module('flash-inventory', 1, 'flash_sheets')

  // ── 2. flash_pieces — 28 pieces across 3 artists ──────────────────────────
  // Artist assignment: artist1 → indices 0–9, artist2 → 10–18, artist3 → 19–27
  const artistForIndex = (i: number): string => {
    if (i < 10) return artistId1
    if (i < 19) return artistId2
    return artistId3
  }

  const pieceRows = PIECE_TEMPLATES.map((t, i) => ({
    id: detId('flash_piece', `spring-drop-2026:${i}`),
    studio_id: ctx.studioId,
    artist_id: artistForIndex(i),
    sheet_id: sheetId,
    title: t.title,
    description: t.description,
    storage_path: `portfolio/demo/${ctx.studioId}/flash/${i}-original.jpg`,
    watermarked_path: `${ctx.studioId}/${artistForIndex(i)}/flash-${i}-wm.jpg`,
    price_cents: t.priceCents,
    currency: 'USD',
    deposit_cents: t.depositCents,
    session_length: t.sessionLength,
    placement: t.placement,
    style_tag_ids: [] as string[],
    is_one_of_one: t.isOneOfOne,
    status: t.status,
    visibility: t.status === 'draft' ? ('private' as const) : ('public' as const),
    is_featured: t.isFeatured,
    view_count: Math.floor((i * 17 + 3) % 120),  // deterministic, non-zero variety
    ai_tagged_at: t.status !== 'draft'
      ? new Date(Date.now() - (i * 3600_000 + 86400_000)).toISOString()
      : null,
    sold_at: t.status === 'sold'
      ? new Date(Date.now() - (i * 86400_000 + 432000_000)).toISOString()
      : null,
    reserved_at: t.status === 'reserved'
      ? new Date(Date.now() - (i * 3600_000 + 7200_000)).toISOString()
      : null,
    created_by: DEMO_USERS.owner.id,
  }))

  const { error: pieceErr } = await sb.from('flash_pieces').upsert(pieceRows, { onConflict: 'id' })
  if (pieceErr) throw new Error(`[flash-inventory] flash_pieces upsert: ${pieceErr.message}`)
  log.module('flash-inventory', pieceRows.length, 'flash_pieces')

  // ── 3. Patch 4 existing artist_portfolio_items with progression paths ──────
  // The members module seeds 2 items per active artist (6 total).
  // We patch the first item for each of the 3 resident artists + 1 second item
  // to demonstrate the full 4-stage Reference→Stencil→Fresh→Healed progression.
  const portfolioPatches = [
    {
      id: detId('portfolio', `${artistId1}:0`),
      reference_path: `portfolio/demo/${ctx.studioId}/prog/a1-0-ref.jpg`,
      stencil_path:   `portfolio/demo/${ctx.studioId}/prog/a1-0-stencil.jpg`,
      fresh_path:     `portfolio/demo/${ctx.studioId}/prog/a1-0-fresh.jpg`,
      healed_path:    `portfolio/demo/${ctx.studioId}/prog/a1-0-healed.jpg`,
      healed_at:      '2026-03-15',
      linked_project_id: ctx.projectIds[0] ?? null,
      ai_tagged_at:   new Date(Date.now() - 30 * 86400_000).toISOString(),
      view_count:     47,
    },
    {
      id: detId('portfolio', `${artistId1}:1`),
      reference_path: `portfolio/demo/${ctx.studioId}/prog/a1-1-ref.jpg`,
      stencil_path:   `portfolio/demo/${ctx.studioId}/prog/a1-1-stencil.jpg`,
      fresh_path:     `portfolio/demo/${ctx.studioId}/prog/a1-1-fresh.jpg`,
      healed_path:    null,      // healed photo not yet submitted — stage 3 only
      healed_at:      null,
      linked_project_id: ctx.projectIds[1] ?? null,
      ai_tagged_at:   new Date(Date.now() - 14 * 86400_000).toISOString(),
      view_count:     22,
    },
    {
      id: detId('portfolio', `${artistId2}:0`),
      reference_path: `portfolio/demo/${ctx.studioId}/prog/a2-0-ref.jpg`,
      stencil_path:   `portfolio/demo/${ctx.studioId}/prog/a2-0-stencil.jpg`,
      fresh_path:     `portfolio/demo/${ctx.studioId}/prog/a2-0-fresh.jpg`,
      healed_path:    `portfolio/demo/${ctx.studioId}/prog/a2-0-healed.jpg`,
      healed_at:      '2026-04-02',
      linked_project_id: ctx.projectIds[2] ?? null,
      ai_tagged_at:   new Date(Date.now() - 7 * 86400_000).toISOString(),
      view_count:     63,
    },
    {
      id: detId('portfolio', `${artistId3}:0`),
      reference_path: `portfolio/demo/${ctx.studioId}/prog/a3-0-ref.jpg`,
      stencil_path:   null,     // stencil not uploaded — stage 1 only so far
      fresh_path:     null,
      healed_path:    null,
      healed_at:      null,
      linked_project_id: null,
      ai_tagged_at:   new Date(Date.now() - 2 * 86400_000).toISOString(),
      view_count:     8,
    },
  ]

  // Upsert patches individually so we don't clobber existing columns not in this delta
  for (const patch of portfolioPatches) {
    const { error: patchErr } = await sb
      .from('artist_portfolio_items')
      .upsert(patch, { onConflict: 'id' })
    if (patchErr) {
      throw new Error(
        `[flash-inventory] artist_portfolio_items patch (id=${patch.id}): ${patchErr.message}`,
      )
    }
  }
  log.module('flash-inventory', portfolioPatches.length, 'artist_portfolio_items (progression patches)')
}
